Find Closest Matches in Two Character Vectors

Source: R/find_closest_match.R
find_closest_match.Rd

Deprecated as of WildObsR 0.2.0. find_closest_match() will be removed in a future release. The function still runs normally; it emits a warning once per session (it is commonly passed to sapply(), so an unguarded warning would fire once per element).

This function finds the closest match between species names provided in an unverified list and a verified species taxonomy database. It handles differences in spelling or capitalization.

Usage

find_closest_match(string, target_strings)

Arguments

string

This is a character vector of species names in the observations that have no matching value in the verified species taxonomy database.

target_strings

This is a character vector of the species names in the verified species taxonomy database to compare against.

Value

A data frame containing the original species names and their closest match from the verified species taxonomy database.

Details

This function internally uses sapply() to apply string distance calculations across all species names in the string vector. The closest match for each name is determined using the Jaro-Winkler string distance method from the stringdist package.
